# Pull Request Template

What does this PR do? (One or two sentences.)

## Related Issue

If this PR fixes or relates to an issue, reference it: #`<issue-number>`

## Details / Notes for Reviewers

- What changed and why?
- Any implementation notes or trade-offs?
- Are there migration steps or required followups?

## Verification

- Steps to reproduce or verify the change locally (if applicable):
  1. npm ci
  2. npm run lint
  3. npm run build
  4. npm run dev (or manual verification steps)

## Checklist

- [ ] Title follows conventional commit style (e.g. `feat:`, `fix:`)
- [ ] PR description explains why the change is needed
- [ ] Linting: `npm run lint` passes locally
- [ ] Build: `npm run build` completes successfully
- [ ] Tests added/updated where applicable
- [ ] At least one reviewer requested
- [ ] CI checks pass

## Screenshots / Recordings (if UI change)

Add any screenshots or a short recording to help reviewers.
